title: Ostrich: Taking Large Strides Through Stiff Contact in Differentiable Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2609.08800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Three properties determine whether a differentiable simulator can drive gradient-based optimization through contact: simulation accuracy, gradient reliability, and per-iteration cost. Tape-based engines such as MJX and Newton Semi-Implicit require timesteps small enough to keep contacts numerically tractable, and their backpropagation memory grows linearly with the number of timesteps T. Surrogate models bound memory by approximating contact away, but the resulting gradients lose the geometry the optimization depends on. We present Ostrich, a GPU-accelerated rigid-body simulator that resolves hard contacts and friction with non-smooth Newton iteration at large timesteps (h ~ 0.1 s), and differentiates the converged residual via the implicit function theorem, reusing the forward Schur complement to compute the adjoint at O(1) memory per timestep. On real-robot trajectories over a pallet obstacle, Ostrich holds MuJoCo's sim-to-real accur

translated_title: Ostrich：在可微动力学中大步跨越刚性接触
translated_abstract: 三个特性决定了一个可微仿真器能否驱动基于梯度的优化穿越接触问题：仿真精度、梯度可靠性和单次迭代成本。基于磁带记录的引擎（如MJX和Newton Semi-Implicit）需要足够小的时间步长才能保持接触问题的数值可处理性，且其反向传播内存随时间步数T线性增长。代理模型通过将接触近似消除来限制内存占用，但由此产生的梯度丢失了优化所依赖的几何结构。我们提出了Ostrich，一个GPU加速的刚体仿真器，它在大时间步长（h ~ 0.1 s）下采用非光滑牛顿迭代法求解硬接触和摩擦问题，并通过隐函数定理对收敛后的残差进行微分，复用前向Schur补来计算伴随变量，使每个时间步仅需O(1)的内存。在跨越托盘障碍物的真实机器人轨迹上，Ostrich保持了与MuJoCo相当的仿真到现实精度……
tldr: Ostrich是一个GPU加速的可微刚体仿真器，通过非光滑牛顿迭代在大时间步长下精确求解硬接触与摩擦，并利用隐函数定理以每步O(1)内存高效计算可靠梯度，同时兼顾仿真精度、梯度可靠性与计算成本。
en_tdlr: Ostrich is a GPU-accelerated differentiable rigid-body simulator that resolves stiff contacts and friction accurately at large timesteps via non-smooth Newton iteration, and computes reliable gradients through the implicit function theorem with O(1) memory per timestep, balancing simulation accuracy, gradient reliability, and per-iteration cost.
